categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the pharmaceutical manufacturing industry, specifically in the research, development, production, and sales of Chinese medicine (TCM) products. The company has 101 drug approval numbers, with products covering 13 therapeutic areas including biliary tract, hypoglycemic, heat-clearing and detoxifying, gynecological, and supplementary categories. The company also operates medical device business (masks) and other ancillary businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs modern pharmaceutical manufacturing technologies combined with traditional Chinese medicine principles. Key technologies include vacuum low-temperature belt technology, ultra-fine grinding technology, centrifugal spray drying technology, and vacuum distillation technology. The company strictly adheres to GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) standards and implements 'sales-driven production' management, with quality control at raw material, intermediate product, and finished product stages.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves hospitals, clinics, health stations, and retail pharmacies across China. Primary customer types include medical institutions and retail consumers. The company has established sales teams for primary, secondary, and tertiary terminals, with major customers including distributors and chain pharmacies. The company's products are covered in national medical insurance catalogs and basic drug lists, serving patients with chronic diseases and general health needs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with sales coverage across all major regions. Key operating regions include East China (27.04% of revenue), South China (20.65%), Southwest China (16.60%), Central China (15.03%), Northwest China (9.74%), North China (8.35%), and Northeast China (2.59%). The company's headquarters and main production facilities are located in Shantou, Guangdong Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain. It manufactures finished pharmaceutical products from raw materials (primarily Chinese medicinal herbs) and distributes them through wholesalers and retailers to end consumers. The company controls procurement of raw materials, production processes, and maintains distribution networks through both direct and indirect channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on innovation-driven development with emphasis on Chinese medicine as the core. R&D priorities include: (1) innovative drugs and medical institution preparations; (2) generic drugs and improved formulations; (3) secondary development of key products; (4) pharmaceutical and food homology products. The company has established innovation platforms including a doctoral workstation and specialized R&D centers, with 59 R&D personnel representing 11.30% of total workforce.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of pharmaceutical products (99.03% of revenue) and medical devices (0.88%). The sales model combines 'distribution + direct sales' approach: distribution through nationwide wholesalers and retailers (92.41% of revenue), and direct sales through chain pharmacies and e-commerce platforms (7.59% of revenue). Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a mid-sized pharmaceutical manufacturer with strong brand heritage as a 'Lingnan old brand' and 'Guangdong old brand' enterprise. The company was recognized as a 'Chinese Time-Honored Brand' in February 2024. Key competitive advantages include 32 original research products, 10 exclusive varieties, and 4 exclusive dosage forms. The company competes in the Chinese medicine pharmaceutical sector against other TCM manufacturers and modern pharmaceutical companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized pharmaceutical manufacturer with 2023 revenue of RMB 292.4 million (3.20% growth YoY). Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was RMB 33.5 million (0.25% growth YoY). The company has total assets of RMB 855.5 million and shareholders' equity of RMB 776.2 million. The company went public on the ChiNext board in December 2021 with an IPO raising RMB 369.7 million in net proceeds.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes quality, innovation, and brand heritage. Key value propositions include: (1) 130+ years of pharmaceutical manufacturing heritage with proven product efficacy; (2) products with national medical insurance and basic drug list coverage, ensuring accessibility; (3) original research and exclusive products providing clinical differentiation; (4) modern manufacturing combining traditional Chinese medicine principles with advanced technology; (5) comprehensive product portfolio addressing multiple therapeutic areas; (6) commitment to 'using heart to protect human health' with focus on chronic disease management and health maintenance.
